mechanism_narrative: The 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is inversely related to S&P 500 forward returns: a 50 basis point decline over the past 3 months predicts positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 60% of instances where the 3-month FEDFUNDS change is below -0.50%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that compresses equity valuations, leading to negative 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: The real interest rate (FEDFUNDS - CPIAUCSL) is inversely related to S&P 500 forward returns: when the real rate exceeds 2.0%, it compresses equity valuations, leading to negative 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where (FEDFUNDS - CPIAUCSL) > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1400 and GDP growth (GDPC1) is below 1.5% annualized, it signals a demand slowdown that leads to negative 60-day returns.
regime_hint: low housing starts and low GDP growth
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1400 and GDPC1 < 1.5% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.5%, it signals a labor market tightening that leads to higher inflation expectations and negative 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months compresses corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines by more than 0.5% over the past 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that leads to negative 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in residential fixed investment (RSAFS) over the past 3 months compresses consumer spending growth expectations, leading to negative 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS declines by more than 0.5% over the past 3 months.
